command_templates.name: basic_usage
command_templates.when: When you want to explore an $MFT file visually.

usage_description: MFT Explorer is a tool for forensic examiners to visualize and explore the contents of an $MFT file, aiding in file system analysis.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Recent access to suspicious files or directories.

suspicious_indicators.description: May indicate changes made by a user or malware.

known_false_positives: Visual exploration of $MFT files can show normal user activities that may be mistaken for suspicious behavior without context.
